judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec, definition of done, and acceptance tests (`src/orchestration/tools/registry.acceptance.test.ts`), without actually implementing the feature in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` or adding `ajv` to `package.json`. Consequently, all the newly added acceptance tests fail immediately because `ToolRegistry.execute` still invokes the executor without validating input. Furthermore, none of the required documentation updates (`README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) or exact test file placements (`registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`) from the acceptance criteria were completed.
